title: Tôi nên sử dụng mạng Wi-Fi nào?
englishTitle: Which Wi-Fi network should I use?
pronunciation: Toi nen su dung mang Wi-Fi nao
summary: Which Wi-Fi network should I use?

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi nên sử dụng mạng Wi-Fi nào? is the quiet opener at a SIM shop, hotel desk, or cafe counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Open the Wi-Fi list and point to the choices. The answer is usually one network name, not a full explanation.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Hear Tôi nên sử + dụng mạng Wi-Fi as the reference point, then compare it with the full phrase.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: What is the Wi-Fi password? and Do you sell SIM cards?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best in a SIM shop, hotel desk, or cafe counter, before the explanation gets long. Keep the phone screen, error message, charger, or map app close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Phone and Wi-Fi answers can be technical. Let the screen stay visible so the other person can point, type, or check the setting.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Keep close by: My phone battery is dead, Do you have a charger, and Can I charge my phone here.
